notes.title: DEMO RELEASE!
notes.notes:
All right, everybody, I have an announcement. If you're ready, this Friday (April 11th) you will be able to play the Mall Simulator 2025 Demo for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582710/Mall_Simulator_2025_Demo/

If you still haven't added it to your wishlist, make sure you do!

Let's shape the game, you and me! Join my Discord server to share all your excitement and feedback on Mall Simulator 2025! ❤️
